about_the_game:
This DLC set includes:

  • Grand Entrance - King of the Skies
    (Upon entering, stuns and deals medium damage to surrounding enemies.)

  • Grand Entrance - Go to Hel!
    (Upon entering, corrodes and deals medium damage to surrounding enemies.)

  • Grand Entrance - From the Fires of War
    (Upon entering, burns and deals medium damage to surrounding enemies.)

  • Grand Entrance - Remember Our Vow
    (Upon entering, blinds and deals light damage to surrounding enemies.)

  • Grand Entrance - Encore
    (Upon entering, cures all status ailments and boosts the attack and defense of surrounding party members.)

*DLC Grand Entrance effects are activated when joining a party during online multiplayer. Upon entering, some animations may apply various effects to enemies and allies during battle.

*Choose the effect that will be used in the settings menu.

*DLC will be accessible in-game after progressing to the necessary point in the story.

content_descriptors.notes: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion contains violence, blood, mild suggestive themes, language, and drug references.
